title: ReLoop E-Waste Analysis
description: Schema for the AI model output returned by the ReLoop e-waste analysis prompt.

item.description: Short name of the e-waste item.

battery_risk.description: Risk level associated with the battery.

swollen_battery.description: Whether the battery appears swollen or bulging.

route.description: Disposal route. Priority: hazard > repair > recycle.

confidence.description: Model confidence in the analysis (0.0 to 1.0).

reason.description: One short sentence explaining the assessment.

safe_steps_en.description: Exactly 3 short safety/handling steps in English.

safe_steps_te.description: Exactly 3 short safety/handling steps in Telugu.
